data.one_liner: A Flutter widget providing a customizable password text field with validation.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a PasswordField widget that can be styled and configured with custom borders, colors, and hint text. It validates input against a user‑provided regex pattern and shows error messages when the constraint is not met.
use_when: You need a simple password input with custom styling and regex validation.
You want a ready‑made widget that supports floating placeholders and error messages without building it from scratch.
avoid_when: You require full form management or integration with authentication backends.
You need advanced password strength meters or multi‑field password confirmation.
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget import
Highly customizable appearance via border and decoration classes
Supports regex‑based password constraints and custom error messages
weaknesses: Limited to password input only, no broader form utilities
No built‑in state management or validation framework integration
May require manual handling of controller and focus logic
